minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  July 25, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, July 25, 2019,
at 2:05 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Arturo Salazar, Planning
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer 2:15

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on July
11, 2019 and Special Meeting of July 11, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Parks and Recreation to host a Food Truck Friday in Downtown Inglewood
  along Market Street, on Friday, July 26, August 23, September 27, 2019,
  from 4:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m., event cancelled by applicant, item pulled.
  (Activity No. 00276156)

Item #2:  Rick Miller of Inglewood Park Cemetery to host a Jazz Concert Tribute to
  Ella Fitzgerald at 720 E. Florence Avenue, on July 28, 2019, from 2:00 p.m.
  - 4:00 p.m., approval for one day event; applicant responsible for crowd
  control and event clean up; utilize Inglewood Park Cemetery uniformed
  security (min. 4 + supervisor) to monitor activity in and outside venue as
  well as traffic control; guards conducting traffic control shall wear reflective
  vest to be seen and use flashlights during hours of darkness/dusk; must
  maintain a clear access for fire trucks and emergency services at all times;
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT
  AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN
  CALLING/NOTIFYING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL,
  ILLEGAL, AND/OR ACTIVITY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE
  RESPONSE OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT
  SERVICES (I.E. CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, PUBLIC
 Permits & License Committee  July 25, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

  WORKS, FIRE DEPT., ETC.) Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00276117)

Item #3:  Eugene Hamilton of Breath of Life Seventh-Day Adventist Church to host
  a Back to School Block party at 425 S. La Brea Avenue, on August 3, 2019,
  from 11:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m., applicant to provide PD guest and sponsor list
  and dignitary list no later than 7 days prior to event; applicant must
  designate 2-4 staff for crowd management, anyone directing traffic in
  parking lot shall wear reflective vest(s) to manage the parking lot for people
  attending the event; area of the parking lot where attendees are expected
  to gather shall be clear of motor vehicles and plastic or wood "A-Frame"
  type, barricades used to separate pedestrian area from vehicle area;
  parked vehicle shall not keep emergency vehicles from entering nor shall
  parked vehicles block off ingress and egress of emergency vehicles or
  services; must separate parking area from area where event will be;
  Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT
  AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN
  CALLING/NOTIFYING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL,
  ILLEGAL, AND/OR ACITIVTY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE
  RESPONSE OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT
  SERVICES (I.E. CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.)
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00276080)

Item #4:  Inglewood Police Department to host an Alliance Neighborhood Watch
  Group – Inglewood Police Dept. Block Party at Larch Street between 97th
  Street and 98th Street, on August 10, 2019, from 11:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.
  North/south ends of Larch Street (between 97th Street and 98th Street)
  shall be blocked off by barricades (A frame, cones, or Police or TCO
  vehicle); No parking notice signs posted min. 72 hours prior on Larch
  Street. PD to coordinate with Public Works and or TCO's (SERCO) for
  posting signs; must not block ingress and egress of residents' primary
  driveway, barricades must be movable for emergency vehicles and
  emergency services access; there shall be a barrier between hot grill area
  and public to avoid fire hazards; No Aerial Drone video/photograph without
  FAA / LAX and PD approval. Canopies to be tied down or weighted down
  to avoid flying away; No Alcoholic beverages allowed or sales or
  consumption/smoking of cannabis products; Adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT AND EMPLOYEES
  ARE  EXPECTED  TO  BE  ACTIVE  PARTICIPANTS  IN
  CALLING/NOTIFYING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL,
  ILLEGAL, AND/OR ACTIVITY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE
  RESPONSE OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT
  SERVICES (I.E. CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, PUBLIC
  WORKS, FIRE DEPT., ETC.) Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00276116)
 Permits & License Committee  July 25, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

Item #5:  Femi Porter of Greater Deliverance Church to host an Anniversary
  Committee Taco Fundraiser at 6741 West Boulevard, on August 10, 2019,
  from 11:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m., Applicant must designate & deploy 2-4 staff
  for crowd management; anyone directing traffic in parking lot shall wear
  reflective vest(s) to manage the parking lot for people attending the event;
  area of the parking lot where attendees are expected to gather shall be
  clear of motor vehicles and plastic or wood "A frame," type barricades used
  to separate pedestrian area from vehicle area; parked vehicles may be
  used as a barrier also (vehicles shall remain parked and not be moved until
  event is over), however parked vehicle shall not keep emergency vehicles
  from entering nor block off ingress and egress of emergency vehicles or
  services; Must separate parking area from area where event will be.
  Applicant to provide PD guest and sponsor list and dignitary list no later
  than 7 days prior to event (if applicable). Adhere to all applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
  state and federal laws. APPLICANT AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED
  TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN CALLING/NOTIFYING POLICE FOR
  POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL, AND/OR ACITIVTY THAT MAY
  NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER
  CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E. CODE ENFORCEMENT,
  PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00276097)

Tobacco Retailer License Request(s):

Item #6:  Maninder Kaur DBA Samy Mini Mart to operate as a tobacco retailer at 400
  W. Manchester Blvd. (Activity No. 00275963)

Item #7:  Sabina Kim DBA GMD Inc. to operate as a tobacco retailer at 224 N. Market
  Street (Activity No. 00276015)

A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE Items #6 and #7 with the
following recommendation. Motion carried unanimously.

  Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically;
  CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN
  THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS; Must adhere to all State and
  Federal Rules and Regulations; Sales or display of single cigarettes is
  strictly prohibited; Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette
  products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing
  tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid government-
  issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or
  display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
  and/or new applicants or their designees are subject to random Permits &
  Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any
  Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by
 Permits & License Committee  July 25, 2019
Minutes  Page 4 of 4

  the City of Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety; Parties, social
  events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; Music boxes, live
  bands/music, disc jockeys (DJ's), etc., is strictly prohibited; California State
  Board of Equalization Tobacco Retailers license must be current.; approval
  for retail sales of tobacco products within existing business ONLY; NO
  sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to minors /
  underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco
  products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the
  restriction of underage tobacco use, including hookah products; Submit all
  state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable; NO loitering of persons
  outside of the location; NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST
  BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof of signage posted
  by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the use of or illegal sales or cultivation of
  marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis products, any use or
  possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia per
  H&S11364.5 - ie; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this
  would also include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used
  specifically to smoke / ingest illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are
  acceptable; the following is not allowed inside the business without proper
  authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit: PARTIES,
  SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke
  box), NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE,
  DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE
  BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF OPERATION.

Business License Renewal Request(s):

Item #8:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law and standard
  business recommendation applicable to each business type. Motion
  carried and second with Planning voting no on Item #2.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity
  No.
  1  Silk Nails  Hair/Nail Salon  00249884

  2  First of All Barber Salon  Hair/Nail Salon  00275067

  3  Inglewood Jewelry & Loan Pawn Shop  00249963

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:28 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
